home.journeyNote: The direction changes; the through-line stays the same: reduce repetition, friction and unnecessary complexity.
home.diagramDesc: The journey evolves from a single development core into a connected automation process and then a five-node AI collaboration network. Scroll to explore each stage.
home.backendDescription: From Gin, WebSocket, Redis and crawling to microservices and small business systems — the backend and systems foundation.
home.automationDescription: Code generation, asset processing, upgrade tools and automation scripts that compress repetitive workflows.
home.agentsDescription: From skills, agent tools and knowledge systems toward permissions, workflows, maintainable deployment and complete enterprise AI systems.
home.principlesNote: Technology is a means. A good system should make the work simpler, not make people adapt to the system.
home.realDescription: Start from an actual need or friction point, not from a technology looking for a problem.
home.minimalDescription: Reuse mature capabilities when possible; if a smaller solution is enough, don't introduce a larger system.
home.maintenanceDescription: Deployment, upgrades, rollback and long-term maintenance are part of the product, not afterthoughts.
home.footerNote: Better tools, more effective work, and a more self-directed life.
